name: sql-injection
description: A parameterised query is replaced with string interpolation.
title: Simplify user lookup query
body: Inline the query, the parameter array was confusing.

before: const result = await pool.query("SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]);
after: const result = await pool.query(`SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE email = '${email}'`);
